title: Goethite nanoparticles binding DNA in dissemination of antibiotic resistance genes: new insights into the role of inorganic phosphate with environmentally relevant concentrations
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,5036-5047
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00765H, Paper
Zaiming Chen, Tianzhu Wang, Kaiyi Zhang, Jiajun Cheng, Meizhen Wang
Iron (oxyhydr)oxides (FeO) significantly influence the environmental dissemination of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) by adsorbing ARG-carrying DNA through phosphate interactions.
